spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.kind == "cooling_tower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value:
        if r._value == 0 then "OFF"
        else if r._value == 1 then "STARTING"
        else if r._value == 2 then "RUNNING"
        else if r._value == 3 then "STOPPING"
        else if r._value == 4 then "FAULT"
        else if r._value == 5 then "UNAVAILABLE"
        else if r._value == 6 then "OPEN"
        else "UNKNOWN",
      _field: r.deviceId
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

hour = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.kind == "cooling_tower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._value == 2 then 1.0 else 0.0
  }))
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _field: "runtimeHours"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["deviceId", "_field", "_value"])

count = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packageStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.kind == "cooling_tower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._value == 2 then 1 else 0
  }))
  |> difference(nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _field: "startCount",
      _value: float(v: r._value)
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["deviceId", "_field", "_value"])


union(tables: [hour, count])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["deviceId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ( { 
    r with avgPerStart: if not exists r.startCount or r.startCount == 0 then r.runtimeHours else r.runtimeHours / r.startCount,
    startCount: if not exists r.startCount then 0.0 else r.startCount
  }))
  |> group()

SELECT
    tower_id,
    total_runtime_seconds
        + CASE
            WHEN current_started_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN FLOOR(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - current_started_at))
            )::bigint
            ELSE 0
          END AS total_runtime_seconds,
    start_count,
    current_started_at,
    last_started_at,
    last_stopped_at
FROM cooling_tower_runtime
WHERE tower_id = '${coolingTower}';
spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    tower_id,
    total_runtime_seconds
        + CASE
            WHEN current_started_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN FLOOR(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - current_started_at))
            )::bigint
            ELSE 0
          END AS total_runtime_seconds,
    coalesce(start_count, 0) as start_count,
    current_started_at,
    last_started_at,
    last_stopped_at
FROM cooling_tower_runtime
WHERE tower_id = '${coolingTower}';
